h2: Two formats, two completely different jobs.
primaryJobNative: Engagement, education, brand authority. Earn the next click by being worth reading.
primaryJobDisplay: Immediate direct response or quick visual awareness; a tap or a brand impression.
readerBehaviourNative: Read at editorial pace — 2 to 3 minutes on page, often shared and saved.
readerBehaviourDisplay: Skipped, blocked, or filtered out by trained ad-blindness. Nine in ten digital display ads are viewed for under one second (Marketing Week).
realEstateNative: Full page or multi-page spread; long-form storytelling with images, pull quotes, data.
realEstateDisplay: Banner, MPU, half-page, takeover — small visual boxes with three to five seconds to land.
trustTransferNative: Inherits the publication's editorial credibility. Reader treats it as journalism-adjacent.
trustTransferDisplay: Treated as an interruption. Trust must come entirely from the brand itself.
longevityNative: Print issues sit on coffee tables and waiting rooms for weeks; digital lives in the archive.
longevityDisplay: Flipped past or scrolled past in seconds; expires the moment the campaign ends.
bestFitNative: Top-funnel work — considered purchases, B2B, premium positioning, brand-building, category education. Pairs with performance, search and sales activity; rarely carries a campaign on its own.
bestFitDisplay: High-frequency awareness, ecommerce retargeting, broad reach at low CPM.
